pairs.target: zhǎngdēng shí , tǎ wéi dào le yuànlǐ .
pairs.english: At lamplight, Tavi arrived in the courtyard.

pairs.target: pà wò méi zài qiángbiān děng tā ,
pairs.english: Pavo wasn't waiting for him by the wall.

pairs.target: zhèng zhàn zài yìqún háizi zhōngjiān ,
pairs.english: He was standing among a crowd of children,

pairs.target: ràng tāmen cāi láng de shétou yǒu duōcháng .
pairs.english: asking them to guess how long the wolf's tongue was.
pairs.hanzi: 让他们猜狼的舌头有多长。

pairs.target: háizi men shēnshǒu bǐhuà ,
pairs.english: The children held out their hands to show the length,

pairs.target: shuí dōu bùkěn bǐ pángbiān de rén duǎn .
pairs.english: and none would go shorter than the child next to them.
pairs.hanzi: 谁都不肯比旁边的人短。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng tāmen bèihòu zǒu guòqù ,
pairs.english: Tavi came around behind them
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从他们背后走过去，

pairs.target: zài mùjià lìngyìtóu zhàn dìng . "
pairs.english: and took his place at the other end of the frame.

pairs.target: wǎng nǎér bān ? "
pairs.english: “Where are we moving it?”

pairs.target: tā wèn .
pairs.english: he asked.

pairs.target: pà wò zhǐzhe láng kǒu .
pairs.english: Pavo pointed at the entrance to the corridor.

pairs.target: nàlǐ zhī diǎn le yìzhǎndēng ,
pairs.english: Only one lamp was lit there,

pairs.target: dìshàng de yǐngzi xié tuō dào yuànzi zhōngjiān .
pairs.english: and the shadow on the ground stretched diagonally to the middle of the courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 地上的影子斜拖到院子中间。

pairs.target: tā shuō yào ràng láng xiān cóng ànchù guòqù ,
pairs.english: He said he wanted the wolf to pass through the dark first,
pairs.hanzi: 他说要让狼先从暗处过去，

pairs.target: háizi men kànjiàn de jiù zhǐshì yǐngzi .
pairs.english: so what the children saw would just be a shadow.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子们看见的就只是影子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wānyāo qù tái ,
pairs.english: Tavi bent to lift it,

pairs.target: pà wò què jiào tā děngděng .
pairs.english: but Pavo told him to wait a moment.

pairs.target: yígè xiǎonǚhái zhèng dūn zài yǐngzi lǐ jìxiédài .
pairs.english: A little girl was crouching in the shadow tying her shoelaces.
pairs.hanzi: 一个小女孩正蹲在影子里系鞋带。

pairs.target: tāmen zhàn zhe děng tā jì hǎo .
pairs.english: They stood and waited for her to finish tying them.

pairs.target: nǚhái zhàn qǐlái ,
pairs.english: The girl stood up,

pairs.target: pāidiào qún jiǎo de tǔ ,
pairs.english: brushed the dirt off the hem of her skirt,

pairs.target: wèn zìjǐ néng bunéng bāng láng jiào yìshēng .
pairs.english: and asked if she could give a howl for the wolf.
pairs.hanzi: 问自己能不能帮狼叫一声。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō kěyǐ ,
pairs.english: Pavo said she could,

pairs.target: dé děng tā zhāngzuǐ .
pairs.english: but she'd have to wait until it opened its mouth.

pairs.target: tā zǒu dào pángbiān ,
pairs.english: She walked to the side

pairs.target: liǎngshǒu wǔzhù zuǐ ,
pairs.english: and covered her mouth with both hands,

pairs.target: xiàngshì pà nà shēng jiào zìjǐ pǎo chūlái .
pairs.english: as if she was afraid the howl might escape by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 像是怕那声叫自己跑出来。

pairs.target: zhèhuí zhuǎnwān shí ,
pairs.english: This time when they turned,

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bù dīng lángtóu le .
pairs.english: Tavi wasn't staring at the wolf's head anymore.

pairs.target: tā kànzhe zìjǐ zhè duān ,
pairs.english: He watched his own end,

pairs.target: děng pà wò bào le yìshēng tíng ,
pairs.english: and waited for Pavo to call out “Stop”

pairs.target: cái jiāng mùjià fàng dī .
pairs.english: before lowering the frame.

pairs.target: dēng xià de láng hūrán ǎileyìjié ,
pairs.english: Under the lamp, the wolf suddenly stood a little shorter,
pairs.hanzi: 灯下的狼忽然矮了一截，

pairs.target: yǐngzi dǎo cháng le .
pairs.english: while its shadow grew longer.

pairs.target: jǐgè háizi jǐ dào qiángbiān ,
pairs.english: Several children squeezed up to the wall.

pairs.target: nàge nǚhái hǎn dé zuì xiǎng ,
pairs.english: That girl called out the loudest,

pairs.target: hǎn wán zìjǐ xiān xiào ,
pairs.english: and laughed herself as soon as she'd finished.

pairs.target: hòumiàn de rén biàn quán gēnzhe xiào .
pairs.english: Then all the people behind her laughed along.

pairs.target: sànchǎng hòu ,
pairs.english: After the show,

pairs.target: pà wò jiāng diàn zài láng zuǐlǐ de bù qǔchū lái ,
pairs.english: Pavo pulled out the cloth that padded the inside of the wolf's mouth

pairs.target: fēngěi tǎ wéi yíkuài cā shǒu .
pairs.english: and gave Tavi a piece to wipe his hands.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mō dào bùlǐ yìxiǎokuài gān ní ,
pairs.english: Tavi felt a little lump of dry mud in the cloth
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸到布里一小块干泥，

pairs.target: xiǎng pāidiào ,
pairs.english: and meant to brush it off.

pairs.target: pà wò shuō liú zhe ba ,
pairs.english: Pavo said, “Leave it.

pairs.target: xiàhuí yàoshi méi rén lái ,
pairs.english: If nobody comes next time,

pairs.target: tā hái kěyǐ zhuāngzuò shì kuài ròu .
pairs.english: it can still pass for a piece of meat.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bù dìhuíqù ,
pairs.english: Tavi handed back the cloth

pairs.target: wèn míngwǎn hái bān bu bān .
pairs.english: and asked if they'd carry it again tomorrow evening.

pairs.target: pà wò shuō bù bān ,
pairs.english: Pavo said they wouldn't.

pairs.target: míngwǎn lún dào biérén yòng zhè tiáo láng .
pairs.english: Tomorrow evening it was someone else’s turn to use this corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 明晚轮到别人用这条廊。

pairs.target: tāmen jiāng mùjià táihuí yuánchù ,
pairs.english: They carried the frame back where it belonged.

pairs.target: chūlái shí
pairs.english: When they came out,

pairs.target: háizi men yǐjīng zǒu guāng ,
pairs.english: the children had already all gone.

pairs.target: zhǐ shèng qiángshàng liǎnggè rén de yǐngzi .
pairs.english: Only the shadows of two people remained on the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 只剩墙上两个人的影子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ tái mùjià de shǒu jǔ qǐlái ,

pairs.hanzi: 塔维把抬木架的手举起来，

pairs.english: On the wall that hand was so big it no longer looked like his own.
pairs.hanzi: 那只手在墙上大得不像自己的。

pairs.target: tā zhāngkāi wǔzhǐ ,
pairs.english: He spread his five fingers.

pairs.target: pà wò shēnshǒu tì tā shǔ le yíbiàn ,

pairs.hanzi: 帕沃伸手替他数了一遍，

pairs.target: cái chuī le dēng .
pairs.english: before blowing out the lamp.
